cutout.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a premium sci-fi aircraft vehicle resource for a Korean collectible RPG, isolated transparent RGBA PNG.
Input image 1 is a DESIGN REFERENCE for the aircraft, not a background to preserve. Transform that design into a polished standalone game vehicle asset.

Subject and design: one complete highly refined black / deep gunmetal / dark teal stealth interceptor. Retain the reference's striking overall character: very long narrow split spear-like forward nose, low embedded smoked-glass cockpit, wide swept angular layered wings, compact intricate recessed mechanical midsection, dramatic upward-swept forked rear fins with negative space between their long straight structural edges, sparse acid-lime green accent panels. Coherent hard-surface engineering and bilateral aircraft design in perspective. A strong clean expensive silhouette, not a bulky generic space freighter, not an animal or humanoid, no wheels. All rigid spars and long leading edges remain straight and consistently aligned, with no melted or bent geometry. Design the cropped-off wings as complete, balanced aircraft structures.

Composition: square high-resolution canvas, a dynamic elevated front three-quarter view like the reference, nose pointing toward the lower left and engines/rear toward the upper right. Show the ENTIRE craft including both wing tips, every fin, nose and exhaust, comfortably inside the canvas with roughly 12 percent transparent margin for the effects. The aircraft occupies about 76–80 percent of the image. No secondary views, no contact sheet.
Materials and lighting: crisp premium game key-art quality, convincing machined alloy, restrained smooth reflective panels, smoked canopy, fine purposeful seams and exposed mechanics in a few recesses. Broad soft studio light makes dark surfaces readable, with sharp pale cool rim light and subtle lime reflections. High-detail clean finish, not gritty, not monochrome silhouette and not covered in noisy tiny ornaments.

Requested aura / aero effects: visually elegant, translucent lime-to-cyan aerodynamic flow ribbons hugging the OUTSIDE of the wing silhouette, two to three fine curved slipstream arcs, delicate wingtip vapor curls, sparse tiny light particles, and concentrated white-hot mint/lime rear engine exhaust trailing backward. A faint green energy corona frames the craft without hiding its silhouette or machinery. Airflow follows the aircraft's nose-to-tail direction and volume. Effects feel like speed and controlled power, not a fire explosion, lightning storm, thick smoke, solid halo disk, magic circle or spherical shield. Keep plenty of clear separation between craft and vapor.

Background: REAL alpha transparency through all empty regions, softly translucent alpha through the aura. No sky, clouds, city, ground, horizon, backdrop gradient, gray bars, baked checkerboard, poster frame or floor shadow.
Text: none. Do not reproduce any logo, signature, watermark, number or emblem from the reference. Deliver a single ready-to-use transparent aircraft resource.

scene.prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: finished landscape vehicle artwork for a premium Korean game inventory and vehicle collection screen.
Input image 1 is the USER-APPROVED aircraft design and aura. Preserve this aircraft's design exactly: same exceptionally long split nose pointing lower-left, black gunmetal/deep teal panels, acid-lime accent inlays, recessed mechanics, smoked low cockpit, swept multi-layer wings, tall elongated open forked rear fins, and mint/lime aura. Do NOT redesign, change its proportions, add new weapons, crop the ship, or replace it with another vehicle. The image is already a finished foreground object; create the environment and environmental lighting around it.

Primary request: turn the approved transparent aircraft into a fully finished cinematic IN-FLIGHT illustration WITH AN ACTUAL BACKGROUND. A breathtaking high-altitude flight above a distant futuristic coastal metropolis, viewed from above the front at three-quarter angle. The craft is banking forward toward the lower left. Maintain the exact approved elevated front-three-quarter view and structural silhouette. Use a wide landscape 3:2 canvas. The complete aircraft occupies roughly 70–75% of the canvas width; give the wing tips, nose, tall rear forks and engine wakes generous safe margins. Never cut off the craft or effect tails.

Background and atmosphere: richly layered ivory cloud banks parting over a deep blue-gray futuristic coastal city far below, shafts of cool early daylight passing through large storm clouds, subtle sunlit warm silver highlights on cloud rims. City towers and road lights are tiny and subdued to convey extreme altitude and scale. A strong diagonal channel of clear air around the aircraft keeps every dark edge readable. The environment feels cinematic, serious, expensive, beautiful, and clearly in flight, with proper depth and perspective. No ground plane touching the craft, no hangar, no runway, no studio void. The backdrop must fill the entire canvas, including corners.

Aura / aero effects: integrate the approved pale mint/lime wing-edge aura into the atmosphere with graceful translucent aerodynamic ribbons and fine wingtip vortex curls, long tapered twin mint-white exhaust wakes receding diagonally into distant cloud, subtle illuminated mist and a sparse few light particles. Glows illuminate only adjacent cloud/vapor; avoid flat bright green fog surrounding everything. Keep the aircraft surface and split nose crisp and exposed. Energy conveys controlled speed, not a giant magical shield, full circular ring, explosion, lightning storm or fireball.

Materials and finish: retain the approved detailed hard-surface appearance with polished alloy highlights, dark readable panels, restrained lime color. High-end sci-fi game promotional vehicle art, sophisticated physically believable cinematic rendering with a painterly finish in the environment. Let neutral rim light separate the dark aircraft from the blue-gray distance.
Constraints: preserve the user-approved foreground design and flight angle; no text, no typography, no product label, no name, no rank, no frame, no logo, no watermark, no extra vehicles or characters, no UI. Opaque finished background, not transparency, no black void or plain gradient.
